name: Eau Palm Beach Resort & Spa
insider_take: This oceanfront paradise sits on 310 feet of pristine Palm Beach coastline, where Old Florida glamour meets modern luxury in perfect harmony.
whats_special: The resort features a stunning 42,000-square-foot spa sanctuary and sits directly across from the exclusive Worth Avenue shopping district. The property boasts seven distinct dining venues and the largest oceanfront pool deck in Palm Beach, complete with private cabanas overlooking the Atlantic.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at Breeze Ocean Kitchen's oceanfront terrace during turtle nesting season (May-October) for a chance to witness loggerhead sea turtles coming ashore.
dont_miss: The legendary Temple Orange tree in the spa garden - it's over 100 years old and produces fruit used in the spa's signature treatments. Also explore the nearby Henry Morrison Flagler Museum, just a 5-minute walk away in the gilded age mansion Whitehall.
pros: Oceanfront location with direct beach access
Full-service luxury spa and wellness facilities
Upscale dining options and beachside service
